biography.plain_text: João Miguel Craveiro Lopes Cortez de Lobão is a Portuguese economist and agricultural entrepreneur. After careers in economic journalism and finance, he took charge of his family's Herdade Maria da Guarda in the Alentejo. He developed the rural property into an integrated olive-growing and milling business and represents producers through the industry association Olivum.

long_biography.plain_text:
In 2006, João Cortez de Lobão took responsibility for Herdade Maria da Guarda and began remaking a centuries-old family estate. He shifted its production from dry cereals towards irrigated olive cultivation, used Alqueva water to expand adjoining land and built a mill around rapid processing for export markets.

The estate later used a private bond issue to finance further planting and land purchases, an unusual funding route for a Portuguese agricultural company. Beyond the business, Cortez de Lobão and his wife, Maria, established the Gaudium Magnum Foundation, supporting culture, education, charitable work and research.
